title: Photos show luxury boat with 50m pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat
english: Satellite images have revealed a large, high-end yacht featuring a 50-meter swimming pool and water slides anchored near a coastal villa used by North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. Experts suggest these vessels are used by the leader and his family for recreation, highlighting a stark contrast to the severe poverty and food shortages faced by the general population. While the exact cost of the luxury boats remains unknown, their presence near the estate matches periods when the leader is absent from public view.
amharic: ሳተላይት ምስሎች የሰሜን ኮሪያ መሪ ኪም ጆንግ ኡን በሚጠቀሙበት የባህር ዳርቻ መኖሪያ አቅራቢያ የ50 ሜትር መዋኛ ገንዳ እና የውሃ መንሸራተቻ ያለው ትልቅ የቅንጦት ጀልባ መገኘቱን ያሳያሉ። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት እነዚህ ጀልባዎች በመሪው እና በቤተሰባቸው ለመዝናኛነት የሚውሉ ሲሆኑ፣ ይህም በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ያለው ሰፊ የድህነት እና የምግብ እጥረት ችግር ጋር ከፍተኛ ልዩነት አለው። የጀልባዎቹ ትክክለኛ ዋጋ ባይታወቅም፣ መገኘታቸው መሪው ከሕዝብ እይታ በተሰወሩባቸው ጊዜያት ጋር የሚገጥም ነው።
oromo: Suuroota saatalaayitii irraa akka hubatametti, doonii gurguddaa fi miidhagoo keessatti daakaa bishaan dheerina meetira 50 fi iddoo bishaan keessa itti taphatan qabu, naannoo mana jireenyaa hogganaa Kooriyaa Kaabaa Kim Jong Un biratti mul'atee jira. Hayyoonni akka jedhanitti, dooniiwwan kun maatii hogganichaa biratti akka bashannanaatti tajaajilu; kunis haala hiyyummaa fi hanqina nyaataa cimaa ummanni biyyattii keessa jiru waliin wal bira qabamee yoo ilaalamu wal-faallaadha. Gatiin dooniiwwan kanaa beekamuu baatus, mul'achuun isaanii yeroo hogganichi beekamtii uummataa irraa fagaatee turetti wal-qabata.

title: A wave of homemade, synthetic drugs sweeps US and deepens crisis
english: The United States is facing an escalating drug crisis driven by the widespread availability of powerful, lab-made synthetic opioids like fentanyl. These substances are increasingly being mixed with other dangerous chemicals, making them significantly more lethal and harder to reverse during an overdose. As usage rates climb, authorities are relying heavily on emergency medication like Naloxone to combat the record-breaking number of overdose deaths occurring across the country.
amharic: አሜሪካ እንደ ፌንታኒል ባሉ ኃይለኛ እና ሰው ሰራሽ አደንዛዥ ዕፆች መስፋፋት የተነሳ ከባድ የዕፅ ቀውስ እየገጠማት ነው። እነዚህ አደንዛዥ ዕፆች ከሌሎች አደገኛ ኬሚካሎች ጋር በመደባለቃቸው ለሕይወት አስጊ ከመሆናቸውም በላይ በሰውነት ላይ ያላቸውን ተጽዕኖ ለመቀልበስ አስቸጋሪ አድርገውታል። የዕፅ ተጠቃሚነት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በመጨመሩ፣ ባለሥልጣናት የሞት አደጋን ለመቀነስ ናሎክሰን የተሰኘውን አስቸኳይ መድኃኒት በስፋት እየተጠቀሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ameerikaan yeroo ammaa kana hanqina fi babal’ina qorichoota sammuu hadoochan kanneen akka fentaanil jedhamaniin rakkoo cimaa keessa jirti. Qorichoonni kunneen keemikaalota biroo waliin makamanii waan gurguramanif, lubbuu galaa fi balaan isaanii hammaachaa dhufeera. Namoonni hedduun sababa kanaatiin lubbuun isaanii darbaa waan jiruuf, mootummaan balaa kana ittisuuf qoricha 'Naloxone' jedhamu fayyadamuun lubbuu oolchuuf tattaaffii gochaa jira.

title: Chelsea’s injury-hit Emi Martinez will return to action ‘in a few weeks’
english: Chelsea goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez successfully underwent surgery after suffering a concussion and a jaw injury during a collision in a match against Everton. The 34-year-old expressed optimism about his recovery and expects to return to the pitch in a few weeks. In his absence, young goalkeeper Mike Penders will step in to cover for Chelsea during their upcoming stretch of competitive fixtures.
amharic: የቼልሲው ግብ ጠባቂ ኤሚሊያኖ ማርቲኔዝ ከኤቨርተን ጋር በተደረገው ጨዋታ በደረሰበት የጭንቅላት እና የመንጋጋ ጉዳት ምክንያት ቀዶ ሕክምና ተደርጎለታል። የ34 ዓመቱ ተጫዋች ህክምናው በጥሩ ሁኔታ መጠናቀቁን ገልጾ፣ በጥቂት ሳምንታት ውስጥ ወደ ሜዳ እንደሚመለስ ተስፋ አድርጓል። እርሱ እስኪመለስ ድረስ ወጣቱ ግብ ጠባቂ ማይክ ፔንደርስ ለቼልሲ ተሰላፊ ሆኖ የሚጫወት ይሆናል።
oromo: Golkeeperii Chelsea Emiliano Martinez tapha Everton wajjin taasisaniin miidhaan mataa fi alangee isaa irra gahee erga qala'ee booda fayyaa ta'eera. Umriin isaa waggaa 34 kan ta'e kun, wal'aansichi milkaa'inaan xumuramuu ibsuudhaan torban muraasa keessatti gara dirree akka deebi'u ibseera. Martinez hanga deebi'utti, golkeeperiin dargaggeessi Mike Penders bakka isaa bu'ee taphachuuf qophiidha.

title: ‘No Kings’ protests spread across the US ahead of midterm elections
english: Across the United States, large crowds gathered for 'No Kings' protests to voice their opposition to President Donald Trump's perceived misuse of authority. Participants used these demonstrations to encourage citizens to participate in early voting before the upcoming midterm elections. The movement highlights growing political tension and the public's focus on electoral accountability.
amharic: በአሜሪካ በተለያዩ ከተሞች በፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የስልጣን አላግባብ አጠቃቀም ላይ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ተካሂደዋል። 'ንጉሥ የለም' በሚል መሪ ቃል የተከናወኑት እነዚህ ሰልፎች፣ መራጮች በመጪው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ላይ ድምፃቸውን በቅድሚያ እንዲሰጡ አሳስበዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ በመንግስት ስልጣን ላይ ቁጥጥር እንዲኖር በመጠየቅ ህዝባዊ ተሳትፎን ለማበረታታት እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: አሜሪካ ውስጥ በተካሄዱት 'No Kings' ወይም 'ነገሥታት የሉም' የተሰኙ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ላይ ቁጥራቸው ከፍተኛ የሆነ ህዝብ በመሳተፍ፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ስልጣናቸውን አላግባብ እየተጠቀሙ ነው በማለት ተቃውሟቸውን ገልጸዋል። ሰልፈኞቹ ህዝቡ በመጪው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ላይ ቀድመው ድምፃቸውን እንዲሰጡ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ በመንግስት ስልጣን ላይ ቁጥጥር እንዲደረግ እና መራጮች በምርጫ ሂደት ላይ ንቁ ተሳትፎ እንዲኖራቸው ለማበረታታት ያለመ ነው።

title: ‘Young protesters across Europe share grievances and tactics’
english: Young people across several European nations, including France, Italy, Belgium, and Albania, are organizing protests to voice their shared frustrations. Experts observe that these demonstrations stem from a growing sense among students that their future is being ignored by current leadership. By sharing common grievances and organizing tactics, these youth movements are demanding greater recognition and consideration for their generation.
amharic: እንደ ፈረንሳይ፣ ጣሊያን፣ ቤልጂየም እና አልባኒያ ባሉ የአውሮፓ ሀገራት የሚገኙ ወጣቶች የጋራ ቅሬታቸውን ለማሰማት ሰላማዊ ሰልፎችን እያደረጉ ነው። የፖሊሲ ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት፣ እነዚህ ተማሪዎች የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታቸው በአመራሮቹ ዘንድ እየተዘነጋ እንደሆነ ይሰማቸዋል። ወጣቶቹ ስልቶቻቸውን በመቀናጀት እና ተመሳሳይ ጥያቄዎችን በማንሳት ለትውልዳቸው ተገቢውን ትኩረት እንዲሰጥ እየወተወቱ ነው።
oromo: Dargaggoonni biyyoota Awurooppaa kanneen akka Faransaay, Xaaliyaanii, Beljiyeem fi Albaaniyaa keessa jiraatan, komii isanii waloon ibsachuuf hiriira ba'aa jiru. Akka ogeeyyiin siyaasaa jedhanitti, hiriirri kun kan maddise barattoonni gara fuulduraa isaanii mootummootaan akka tuffatame itti dhaga'amu irraayyi. Dargaggoonni kun mala qabsoo wal jijjiirrachuudhaan fi rakkoowwan waloo qaban kaasuun, dhaloota isaaniif xiyyeeffannoon akka kennamu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Photos: Protests across France spiral into looting, blazes and clashes
english: Massive protests against the high cost of living and poor school conditions across France recently descended into widespread violence, looting, and arson. Authorities have arrested approximately 1,200 individuals, while 150 police officers sustained injuries during clashes in major cities. President Macron has condemned the destruction of public property and vowed that those involved in the unrest will face legal consequences.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ ከፍተኛ የኑሮ ውድነትን እና በትምህርት ቤቶች ያለው የከፋ ሁኔታ በመቃወም በተደረጉ ሰልፎች ከፍተኛ ሁከት፣ ዝርፊያ እና የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቷል። ባለሥልጣናት እንደገለጹት በአገሪቱ በተለያዩ ከተሞች በተደረጉ ግጭቶች 1,200 ሰዎች ታስረው 150 የፖሊስ አባላት ቆስለዋል። ፕሬዝዳንት ማክሮን በሕዝብ ንብረት ላይ ጉዳት ያደረሱ አካላት በሕግ እንደሚጠየቁ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Faransaay keessatti mormii gatii jireenyaa olka’uu fi haala barnootaa irratti fuulleffate gara jeequmsaa, saamichaa fi gubatii qabeenyaatti jijjiiramee jira. Humnoonni nageenyaa namoota 1,200 ol to’annaa jala oolchanii jiru, akkasumas poolisoonni 150 ol miidhamanii jiru. Preezdaant Maakroon miidhaa qabeenya ummataa irratti qaqqabe balaaleffachuun, kanneen jeequmsa kana keessatti hirmaatan hundi seeraan akka gaafataman dubbatanii jiru.

title: There is no split in MAGA
english: Despite rumors of a fracture within the MAGA coalition, the movement remains united in its core values. The author argues that instead of splitting, the group is facing an intentional effort by political elites to redefine its identity. This shift incorporates hawkish, pro-war ideologies that contradict the movement's original focus on peace and challenging the establishment.
amharic: የማጋ (MAGA) ጥምረት ተከፋፍሏል የሚለው ወሬ መሰረት የለውም፣ ይልቁንም ንቅናቄው አሁንም እንደተዋሃደ ነው። ጸሐፊው እንደሚሉት፣ ችግሩ የቡድኑ መከፋፈል ሳይሆን፣ የፖለቲካ ልሂቃን የንቅናቄውን መርህ ለመቀየር የሚያደርጉት ጥረት ነው። ይህ ለውጥ የቀድሞውን የሰላም እና የመንግስት አስተዳደርን የመቃወም መርህ በመተካት ወደ ጦርነት አቀንቃኝ አስተሳሰብ እንዲያዘነብል እያደረገው ነው።
oromo: Hiriirri MAGA jedhamu cabee jira kan jedhamu dhugaarraa kan fagaatedha; gareen kun ammas tokkummaa isaa eeggatee jira. Barreessaan akka jedhutti, rakkoon jiru gareen kun gargar ba'uu utuu hin taane, qaamoleen siyaasaa dhaabbaticha jijjiiruuf carraaqaat jiru. Jijjiirraan kun immoo imala jalqabaa kan nagaa fi mormii mootummaarraa gara ilaalcha waraanaatti goruu akka qabuufi taasisaa jira.

title: Egyptian parliament to discuss defensive aid to Saudi Arabia
english: The Egyptian parliament is convening an emergency session to debate President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi's proposal to provide defensive military support to Saudi Arabia. While the President emphasized that Egypt is committed to protecting its ally, he clarified that any potential assistance would be limited strictly to defensive measures. Lawmakers are meeting to decide whether to officially authorize this request.
amharic: የግብፅ ፓርላማ ፕሬዝዳንት አብዱል ፋታህ አል-ሲሲ ለሳዑዲ አረቢያ የመከላከያ ወታደራዊ እርዳታ ለመስጠት ያቀረቡትን ጥያቄ ለመወያየት አስቸኳይ ስብሰባ እየጠሩ ነው። ፕሬዝዳንቱ የሳዑዲ አረቢያን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ ግብፅ ቁርጠኛ መሆኗን ቢገልጹም፣ የሚደረገው ድጋፍ በመከላከያ ላይ ብቻ የተወሰነ እንደሚሆን አሳስበዋል። የፓርላማ አባላት ይህንን ጥያቄ በይፋ ማጽደቅ አለመጽደቃቸውን ለመወሰን እየመከሩ ነው።
oromo: Parlamaan Gibxii pirezidaant Abdel Fattaah al-Siisii deeggarsa waraanaa ittisaa Sa’udii Arabiyaaf akka kennamuuf dhiyeessan irratti mari’achuuf yaada hatattamaa waameera. title: Israeli attack kills Palestinian man in Gaza's Khan Younis
english: An Israeli military operation in Khan Younis resulted in the death of a Palestinian man. This incident occurred shortly after another attack, where a drone strike near Gaza City left four people injured. These events highlight the ongoing violence and escalating tensions within the region.
amharic: በካን ዩኒስ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃት አንድ ፍልስጤማዊ ህይወቱ አልፏል። ይህ ክስተት የደረሰው ጋዛ ከተማ አቅራቢያ በድሮን ጥቃት አራት ሰዎች ከቆሰሉ በኋላ ነው። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በአካባቢው እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ግጭት ያሳያሉ።

title: The wedding couple who broke the 'Palestine hate march' myth
english: A newly married couple recently joined a pro-Palestine protest in London while wearing their wedding attire, which sparked a significant amount of online vitriol and harsh criticism. The author argues that this backlash highlights the irony of those who label these demonstrations as 'hate marches,' as the couple clearly felt safe and comfortable celebrating among the protestors. By documenting this moment, the couple showed support for the cause, countering negative political narratives that characterize these gatherings as dangerous or extremist.
amharic: በቅርቡ ለንደን ውስጥ የተጋቡ ጥንዶች በሰርጋቸው ቀን የፍልስጤምን ደጋፊዎች ሰልፍ በመቀላቀላቸው በኢንተርኔት ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ እና ትችት ገጥሟቸዋል። የጽሁፉ ደራሲ እንደሚለው፣ ይህ ሁኔታ ሰልፎችን 'የጥላቻ ሰልፍ' ብለው የሚፈርጁትን ወገኖች እውነትነት የሚጠይቅ ነው፤ ምክንያቱም ጥንዶቹ በሰልፈኞቹ መካከል ደህንነት ተሰምቷቸው ነበር። ይህ ክስተት ሰልፎቹን እንደ አደገኛ ወይም አክራሪ አድርጎ ለማሳየት የሚሞክሩትን የፖለቲካ ትርክቶች ውድቅ የሚያደርግ ነው።
oromo: Goototni haaraa gaa'ela godhatan tokko London keessatti hiriira deggarsa Palastiinii irratti uffata gaa'elaa isaaniitiin hirmaachuun isaanii mormii fi arrabsoo gurguddaa miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti isaan mudateera. Barreessaan kun akka jedhutti, gochi kun namoota hiriirawwan akkasii 'hiriira jibbaa' jedhanii moggaasan irratti gaaffii guddaa uuma, sababni isaas qabsiisoonni kun gidduu hiriirtotaa sanaatti tasgabbii fi gammachuu waan itti dhaga'ameef. Suuraan kun, hiriirawwan akkasii balaa ykn kan daangaa darban ta'uu isaanii irratti ibsa siyaasaa dhiyaatu mormuuf gargaara.

title: ​​Libya: Racism and ‘resettlement’ conspiracies fuel fear among Tripoli’s migrants
english: Migrants in Tripoli are facing increased hostility and xenophobic threats fueled by conspiracy theories and organized protests. Despite recent demonstrations being smaller than expected, foreign nationals continue to deal with harassment, systemic abuse, and limited access to public spaces. With Libya serving as a major transit point for those attempting to reach Europe, the rise in local anti-migrant sentiment has created a dangerous environment for the city's large refugee and migrant population.
amharic: በትሪፖሊ የሚገኙ ስደተኞች በተቀነባበሩ የጥላቻ ቅስቀሳዎች እና በዘረኝነት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ውስጥ ወድቀዋል። ምንም እንኳን የተደራጁት የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ከታሰበው በታች ቢሆኑም፣ ስደተኞች በዕለት ተዕለት ሕይወታቸው የሚያጋጥማቸው እንግልት እና መገለል እየጨመረ መጥቷል። ሊቢያ ለአውሮፓ መዳረሻ ዋና የሽግግር ማዕከል በመሆኗ፣ በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ዘንድ እየተባባሰ የመጣው የፀረ-ስደተኛ ስሜት በከተማዋ ለሚኖሩ በርካታ ስደተኞች ህይወት አስጊ ሆኗል።
oromo: Godina Tiripoli keessa kan jiraatan godaantonnii fi baqattoonni, sochiiwwan jibbaa fi yaada dogoggoraa irratti hundaa'e irraa kan ka'e soda keessa galaniiru. Hiriirri mormii qindaa'e kun akka yaadame guddachuu baatus, godaantonnii fi baqattoonni miidhaa, jibbaa fi tajaajila hawaasummaa argachuu irratti rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru. Liibiyaan iddoo godaantonnii gara Awurooppaatti itti ce'an waan taateef, jibbi uummata keessatti babal'achaa jiru kun jireenya baqattootaa miidhaa keessa galcheera.

title: Israeli forces advance into Syria's Quneitra province, Al Jazeera reports
english: Israeli military forces have moved into the al-Makar region of Syria's Quneitra province using six vehicles. This follows recent Israeli raids and search activities conducted in the nearby village of Rasm al-Haydarah. The area has experienced a pattern of ongoing Israeli military incursions and artillery strikes.

title: Heidi Levine undergoes surgery on 'nearly detached' finger, daughter says
english: Photojournalist Heidi Levine is recovering after surgery to repair a finger that was nearly severed during a violent assault by Israeli settlers in the West Bank. In addition to her hand injury, she suffered several broken ribs and vertebrae, surviving only because she was wearing protective gear. Levine stated that she was repeatedly kicked while on the ground, an experience that confirmed her son's long-standing fears for her safety while working.

title: Israeli military sat on distress calls about settler attacks for two hours, report says
english: A recent report reveals that the Israeli military delayed responding to distress calls for two hours during a settler attack on Palestinians and diplomats in the West Bank. Despite receiving clear location data and urgent warnings from activists, troops only became involved after the violence had already finished. The military is currently investigating the delay, while human rights organizations highlight an ongoing pattern of settler violence disrupting the Palestinian olive harvest.
amharic: በምዕራብ ባንክ በሰፋሪዎች ስለተፈጸመ ጥቃት የደረሰውን የእርዳታ ጥሪ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል ለሁለት ሰዓታት ችላ ማለቱን አንድ ዘገባ አጋልጧል። አክቲቪስቶች ትክክለኛውን ቦታ እና አስቸኳይ ማስጠንቀቂያ ቢሰጡም፣ ወታደሮቹ ጣልቃ የገቡት ጥቃቱ ካበቃ በኋላ ነው። በዚህ መዘግየት ዙሪያ ምርመራ እየተካሄደ ሲሆን፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ድርጅቶች ይህ ክስተት በፓለስቲናውያን የወይራ ምርት ላይ እየደረሰ ካለው ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃት አንዱ መሆኑን እየገለጹ ነው።
oromo: Gabaasni tokko akka agarsiisutti, waraanni Israa'el iddoo Bataskaana Dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti namoota saafaranii fi lafa qabatanii jiran (settlers) namoota Falasxiin irratti haleellaa raawwatan kan isaan beeksisan yeroo sa'aatii lamaaf callisanii turan. title: Eight Yemeni government forces killed in battle with Houthis
english: Eight Yemeni government soldiers lost their lives during a clash with Houthi fighters in the Lahj province. The government military command confirmed the casualties occurred at the Maqatirah front. Prior to this, government forces also reported successfully killing 12 Houthi militants in the southern region of Taiz.
amharic: በየመን የላሂጅ ግዛት ውስጥ በመንግስት ወታደሮች እና በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መካከል በተደረገ ግጭት ስምንት የመንግስት ወታደሮች ተገድለዋል። የመንግስት ወታደራዊ አመራር ጉዳቱ የደረሰው በማቃቲራ ግንባር መሆኑን አረጋግጧል። ከዚህ ግጭት ቀደም ብሎም የመንግስት ሃይሎች በታኢዝ ደቡባዊ ክፍል 12 የሁቲ ታጣቂዎችን መግደላቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Godina Lahj keessatti waraana mootummaa Yamanifi hidhattoota Hutiin gidduutti walitti bu'iinsa uumameen waraanni mootummaa saddeet du'aniiru. Ajajni waraana mootummaa miidhaan kun kan mudate addabaabayii Maqatiraa irratti ta'uu mirkaneesseera. Kana dura, waraanni mootummaa naannoo Ta'iz kibbaatti hidhattoota Huti 12 ajjeesu isaanii ibsanii turan.

title: El Niño Reaches the Fields Before the Warnings Do
english: Parts of Ethiopia are experiencing a severe drought that has destroyed crops and livestock across multiple regions. Approximately 9.3 million people are currently affected by this food insecurity. Weather forecasting systems are struggling to provide timely alerts as the climate shifts between drought and potential flooding.
amharic: በኢትዮጵያ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች የተከሰተው ድርቅ ሰብሎችን በማውደም እና ከብቶችን በመግደል ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እያደረሰ ይገኛል። በዚህ የተፈጥሮ አደጋ ወደ 9.3 ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ለምግብ እጥረት ተጋልጠዋል። የአየር ሁኔታ ትንበያ ሥርዓቶች ከድርቅ ወደ ጎርፍ በሚሸጋገረው አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ወቅታዊ ማስጠንቀቂያ ለመስጠት እየታገሉ ነው።
oromo: Naannoolee Itoophiyaa gara garaatti hongeen cimaan mudate midhaan mancaasuu fi horii fixuu irraa kan ka'e rakkoo hamaa uumee jira. Namoonni miiliyoona 9.3 ta'an rakkoo nyaataatiif saaxilamaniiru. Sirnoonni ibsa qilleensaa hongee fi rooba cimaa gidduutti jijjiirama jiru hordofee akeekkachiisa yeroon kennuuf dhama'aa jiru.

title: Ethiopia Outgrows IMF Quota as Smaller Neighbours Fear the Fix
english: Ethiopia's rapid economic expansion has outpaced its current stake in the International Monetary Fund, which currently sits at roughly 410 million dollars. IMF officials recognize that this mismatch between the country's actual economic size and its official quota is significant. As a result, the Fund provided Ethiopia with special financial access worth over 3.4 billion dollars to support its ongoing development.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ፈጣን የኢኮኖሚ እድገት በአለም አቀፉ የገንዘብ ድርጅት (IMF) ያላትን ድርሻ በአሁኑ ሰዓት እያስበለጠ ይገኛል። የድርጅቱ አመራሮች የሀገሪቱን ትክክለኛ የኢኮኖሚ አቅም ከድርሻዋ ጋር አለመመጣጠኑን ተገንዝበዋል። ይህንን ክፍተት ለመቅረፍም ኢትዮጵያ በነበራት የኢኮኖሚ እድገት ታሳቢነት ከ3.4 ቢሊዮን ዶላር በላይ የሆነ ልዩ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ አግኝታለች።
oromo: Guddinni dinagdee Itoophiyaa ariifataan sadarkaa qooda isheen Dhaabbata Maallaqa Addunyaa (IMF) keessatti qabdu caalaa jira. Hoji gaggeestonni IMF akka ibsanitti, qoodni Itoophiyaa guddina dinagdee ishee waliin wal-madaaluu dhabuun isaa ni beekama. Rakkoo kana furuuf, dhaabbatichi Itoophiyaaf deeggarsa addaa kan dalarri biliyoona 3.4 ol ta'u kennuun isaa guddina biyyattii deeggaruuf murtaa'eera.

title: Railway Corp Wins on Size, Loses on Cost in Turkish Arbitration
english: The Ethiopian Railways Corporation has been ordered by a London tribunal to resolve payment terms with the Turkish firm Yapi Merkezi following a legal dispute. While the government has taken over a significant portion of the corporation's debt, the entity is currently funding the final seven percent of its railway project independently. Construction is expected to conclude within the next two years.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ምድር ባቡር ኮርፖሬሽን ከቱርኩ ተቋራጭ ያፒ መርኬዚ ጋር ያለውን የክፍያ ሁኔታ በለንደን ፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ መሰረት እንዲያስተካክል ታዟል። ምንም እንኳን መንግስት የኮርፖሬሽኑን ከፍተኛ እዳ ወደ ፋይናንስ ሚኒስቴር ቢያስተላልፍም፣ ኮርፖሬሽኑ ቀሪውን ሰባት በመቶ የባቡር ግንባታ በራሱ በጀት በማከናወን ላይ ይገኛል። የቀረው ግንባታ በሁለት ዓመት ጊዜ ውስጥ ይጠናቀቃል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Hoggansi daandii baaburaa Itoophiyaa mana murtii Landanitti dhaabbata Turkii Yaapii Merkeezii waliin haala kaffaltii irratti akka walii galu ajajameera. Mootummaan liqii dhaabbatichaa gara Ministeera Maallaqaatti kan jijjiire yoo ta'u, amma qofatti dhaabbatichi hojii ijaarsa daandii baaburaa kan hafe harka torba keessaa xumuruuf ofii isaatii baasii godhaa jira. Ijaarsi kun waggaa lama keessatti ni xumurama jedhamee eegama.

title: Judges Summon Sandford’s Chiefs Over Students They’re Told to Keep
english: The Federal High Court has summoned the leadership of Sandford International School regarding a legal dispute involving the school's obligations to its students. This follows a recent court ruling that invalidated the legal grounds previously used by the institution and other private schools to justify tuition fee hikes. As a result, the management of this long-standing elite school is facing increased scrutiny over its operational practices.
amharic: የፌዴራል ከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት የሳንድፎርድ ኢንተርናሽናል ትምህርት ቤት አመራሮችን በተማሪዎች ጉዳይ ላይ ባለው ክርክር እንዲቀርቡ አዟል። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው ቀደም ሲል ትምህርት ቤቶች የትምህርት ክፍያ ጭማሪ ለማድረግ ይጠቀሙበት የነበረው ህጋዊ መሰረት በቅርቡ በፍርድ ቤት ውድቅ መደረጉን ተከትሎ ነው። በዚህም ምክንያት የትምህርት ቤቱ አስተዳደር በአሰራሩ ዙሪያ ከፍተኛ ክትትል እየተደረገበት ይገኛል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa federaalaatti hogganoonni mana barumsaa idil-addunyaa Sandford dhimma barattootaa irratti wal-falmii jiruuf akka dhiyaatan ajajameera. Ajajni kun kan dhufe erga mana murtichaa kanaan dura mana barumsichi fi manneen barnoota dhuunfaa biroon gatii barnootaa dabaluuf itti fayyadamaa turan irra deebi'amee akka hin hojjenne erga murtaa'ee booda. Kana hordofees, bulchiinsi mana barumsaa kanaa haala hojiisaa irratti dhiibbaa fi hordoffii cimaa keessa galeera.

title: Last of Six to Close, Ethiopia Sets December for Bond Swap
english: Ethiopian authorities have announced that the restructuring of the country's one-billion-dollar defaulted Eurobond is expected to be finalized by the end of December. This move follows a period of financial instability and marks the final step in a series of debt-related measures taken by the government. The exchange process is intended to stabilize the nation's international financial standing.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት የአንድ ቢሊዮን ዶላር የዩሮ ቦንድ እዳ ክፍያ ማሻሻያ ስራ በታህሳስ ወር መጨረሻ እንደሚጠናቀቅ አስታውቋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ቀደም ሲል የነበረውን የገንዘብ ክፍያ ችግር ለመፍታት እና የሀገሪቱን አለም አቀፍ የፋይናንስ አስተማማኝነት ለማሳደግ ነው። ይህ የመጨረሻው የዕዳ ልውውጥ ሂደት የሀገሪቱን የኢኮኖሚ መረጋጋት ለማምጣት የታቀደ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Itoophiyaa liqii biyyattii kan Eurobond jedhamu kan biliyoona tokko ga’u, hanga dhuma ji'a Muddeetti akka fooyyeessuuf karoorfate beeksiseera. Tarkaanfiin kun rakkoo liqii kanaan dura ture furuufi amanamummaa dinagdee biyyattii gabaa addunyaa irratti cimsuuf kan karoorfameedha. Adeemsi jijjiirraa liqii kun xumura tattaaffii mootummaan dinagdee biyyattii tasgabbeessuuf taasisaa ture keessaa isa tokko.

title: Iran war live: Tankers hit in Hormuz; Israeli settlers attack EU diplomats
english: Tensions have escalated following reports of fires on multiple oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and the Sea of Oman, with Iran claiming mines were involved. Meanwhile, in the occupied West Bank, masked Israeli settlers physically assaulted European diplomats and damaged their vehicles. These separate incidents contribute to growing instability in both the Middle East and the Palestinian territories.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ እና በኦማን ባህር ውስጥ በበርካታ የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከቦች ላይ የእሳት አደጋ መከሰቱን ተከትሎ ውጥረቱ አድጓል፤ ኢራን በአደጋው ፈንጂዎች እንደተጠቀሙበት አስታውቃለች። በሌላ በኩል በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ፣ ጭንብል የለበሱ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በአውሮፓ ዲፕሎማቶች ላይ አካላዊ ጥቃት በመሰንዘር ተሽከርካሪዎቻቸውን አውድመዋል። እነዚህ ተያያዥነት የሌላቸው ክስተቶች በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ እና በፍልስጤም ግዛቶች እየተባባሰ የመጣውን አለመረጋጋት አመላካች ናቸው።
oromo: Hormuz fi Galaana Oomaan keessatti dooniiwwan boba’aa hedduu irratti ibiddi ka’uu hordofee walitti bu’iinsi dabaleera; Iraanis rakkoon kun kan dhufe minaayiiwwan (miina) fayyadamuun akka ta’e ibsiteetti. Gama biraatiin, naannoo Weest Baank qabamee jiru keessatti, jiraattonni Israa’el fuula haguuggatanii dipiloomatoota Awurooppaa irratti haleellaa qaamaa raawwataniiru akkasumas konkolaattoota isaanii mancaasaniiru. Taateewwan kun naannoo Baha Giddu-galeessaa fi guutummaa naannolee Falasxiin keessatti tasgabbii dhabuu guddaa mul’isu.

title: US ambassador urges Israel to prosecute attackers of American journalist
english: US Ambassador Mike Huckabee has demanded that Israel arrest and prosecute the individuals who severely injured American photojournalist Heidi Levine during an attack in the occupied West Bank. Levine was assaulted by a group while documenting an olive harvest, suffering serious injuries including broken bones and a damaged finger. Although the ambassador strongly condemned the violence as an act of terror, the Israeli Prime Minister has attempted to deflect blame by suggesting other groups might be responsible.
amharic: የአሜሪካው አምባሳደር ማይክ ሃክቢ በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ በደረሰ ጥቃት የአሜሪካዋን ጋዜጠኛ ሃይዲ ሌቪን ክፉኛ ለጎዱ አካላት ላይ እስራኤል እርምጃ እንድትወስድ ጠይቀዋል። ጋዜጠኛዋ የወይራ ምርት መሰብሰብን እየዘገበች እያለ በቡድን ተደብድባ ከፍተኛ የአካል ጉዳት ደርሶባታል። አምባሳደሩ ጥቃቱን አስጸያፊ የሽብር ተግባር ሲሉ ቢኮንኑትም፣ የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ግን ጥቃቱ በሌሎች አካላት የተፈጸመ ሊሆን እንደሚችል በመግለጽ ጉዳዩን ለማደናገር ሞክረዋል።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa Maayik Haakbi, gaazexeessituu Ameerikaa Haydii Leeviin gammoojjii Weest Baank keessatti erga miidhamtee booda, Israa'el qabxiiwwan kana irratti tarkaanfii akka fudhattu gaafataniiru. Gaazexeessituun kun yeroo midhaan wayinanii gurguratan gabaasaa turteetti garee tokkoon reebamuun miidhaan cimaan irra ga'eera. Ambaasaaddarichi haleellaa kana balaaleffataniiruus, muummeen ministiraa Israa'el garuu haleellaan kun garee biraatiin raawwatame ta'uu danda'a jechuun shakkii uumuuf yaalaniiru.

title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts drones as Egypt weighs sending help
english: The Saudi-led coalition successfully intercepted four Houthi-launched drones targeting Riyadh and other regions in Saudi Arabia. This incident follows a series of recent attacks on Saudi oil facilities and infrastructure that have caused casualties. In response, Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi has expressed a willingness to support Saudi Arabia's defense if requested, though he emphasized that he is not seeking a broader regional conflict.
amharic: የሳዑዲ ጥምረት በሪያድ እና በሌሎች የሳዑዲ አረቢያ አካባቢዎች ላይ በሁቲ አማፂያን የተላኩ አራት ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላኖችን (ድሮኖችን) መትቶ ጥሏል። ይህ ድርጊት በቅርቡ በሳዑዲ የነዳጅ ማቀነባበሪያዎች እና መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃት ከተፈጸመ በኋላ የመጣ ነው። ለዚህም ምላሽ የግብፁ ፕሬዝዳንት አብዱል ፈታህ አል-ሲሲ፣ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ በጠየቀችው መሰረት ሀገራቸውን ለመከላከል ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ ነገር ግን ግብፅ ወደ ቀጠናዊ ጦርነት ለመግባት ፍላጎት እንደሌላት አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Mootummoota gamtoomaniin Saudi Arabia hoogganamu, xiyyaara malee to’ataman afur kanneen Houthiin gara Riyad fi naannolee biroo Saudi Arabia tti ergame barbadeessaniiru. Gochi kun erga gamoowwan boba’aa fi dhaabbileen mootummaa Saudi Arabia irratti haleellaan gaggeeffamee booda kan dhufe dha. Kanaan walqabatee, prezidaantiin Gibtsii Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, yoo Saudi Arabia gaafatte ittisa biyyattii gargaaruuf qophii ta’uu isaanii ibsan; ta’us, Gibtsiin walitti bu’iinsa naannawaa keessa seenuuf fedhii akka hin qabne beeksisaniiru.

title: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as over 1,000 arrested after protests
english: Widespread protests in France regarding education and living costs turned into violent riots, leading to over 1,200 arrests. Demonstrators engaged in looting, vandalism, and arson across several cities, causing significant damage to historic buildings and businesses. During the chaotic clashes, 150 police officers were injured, and authorities struggled to contain the fires as protesters obstructed emergency services.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ በትምህርት እና በኑሮ ውድነት ምክንያት የተቀሰቀሱ ተቃውሞዎች ወደ አመጽ በመቀየራቸው ከ1,200 በላይ ሰዎች ታስረዋል። በተለያዩ ከተሞች ተቃዋሚዎች ዘረፋ፣ የንብረት ውድመት እና የእሳት አደጋዎችን በማድረሳቸው ታሪካዊ ህንጻዎች እና የንግድ ተቋማት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሷል። በግጭቱ 150 የፖሊስ አባላት የቆሰሉ ሲሆን፣ ተቃዋሚዎች የእሳት አደጋ መከላከያ ሰራተኞችን ስራ በማስተጓጎላቸው ሁኔታውን ለመቆጣጠር አስቸጋሪ ሆኗል።
oromo: Faransaatti mormiin waa'ee barnootaa fi gatii jireenyaa irratti ka'e gara jeequmsaatti jijjiiramuun namoonni 1,200 ol ta'an to'annoo jala oolaniiru. Magaalota garaagaraa keessatti mormitoonni saaminsa, mancaatii qabeenyaa fi gubiinsa gaggeessuun, gamoo seena qabeessaa fi bakkeewwan daldalaa irratti miidhaan cimaan ga'eera. Walitti bu'iinsa uumameen poolisoonni 150 madaa'aniiru; akkasumas mormitoonni hojjettoota dhaamsi-ibiddaa dhowwuu isaaniitiin ibiddicha to'achuun ulfaataa ta'eera.

title: European diplomats attacked by Israeli settlers in West Bank
english: A group of European diplomats, including officials from Belgium and France, were attacked by masked Israeli settlers while visiting the West Bank to observe the impact of recent violence on Palestinian olive harvests. During the incident, vehicles were damaged and a French official was physically harmed, prompting strong condemnation from international leaders who demanded accountability. While the Israeli military and foreign minister denounced the violence, some government officials suggested the reports were being exaggerated to damage Israel's reputation.
amharic: የቤልጂየም እና የፈረንሳይን ዲፕሎማቶች ጨምሮ የአውሮፓ ልዑካን በዌስት ባንክ በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት ደረሰባቸው። ዲፕሎማቶቹ በቦታው የተገኙት እስራኤላውያን ሰፋሪዎች በፓለስቲናውያን ላይ እያደረሱ ስላለው ጥቃት ለመታዘብ ነበር። በዚህ ጥቃት የተሽከርካሪ መስኮቶች የተሰበሩ ሲሆን የፈረንሳይ ባለስልጣንም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ዓለም አቀፍ አካላት ጥቃቱን በጽኑ ያወገዙ ሲሆን እስራኤል ተጠያቂዎችን ለፍርድ እንድታቀርብ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni dippiloomaasii Awurooppaa, kanneen biyyoota Beeljiyeemii fi Faransaay irraa dhufan, naannoo Weest Baankitti gartuu Israa'eloota lafa qabatanii jiraatan biratti haleelamanii jiru. Dippiloomaassonni kun kan achi dhaqan rakkoo qotee bulaa Palastinoonni oomisha ejersaa isaanii sassaabbachuu irratti isaan mudachaa jiru qorachuuf ture. Haleellaa kanaan konkolaattonni cabanii fi aanga'aan Faransaay tokko miidhamaniiru; biyyoonni Awurooppaas tarkaanfii kana balaaleffachuun Israa'el yakkattoota seeratti dhiheessuu akka qabdu gaafataniiru.

title: Anti-government protesters battle with police in Albania
english: Violent anti-government demonstrations have escalated in Tirana, Albania, marking the fifth consecutive day of clashes between protesters and police. Demonstrators, largely composed of students, are demanding the prime minister's resignation due to corruption allegations and have engaged in battles involving petrol bombs and rocks. Authorities have responded with tear gas, water cannons, and rubber bullets, resulting in numerous injuries and mass arrests.
amharic: በአልባኒያ ዋና ከተማ ቲራና በተነሱ ፀረ-መንግስት ሰልፎች ተቃዋሚዎች እና የፀጥታ አስከባሪዎች ለተከታታይ አምስት ቀናት ግጭት ውስጥ ገብተዋል። ተማሪዎች በብዛት የሚሳተፉባቸው እነዚህ ሰልፎች የመንግስትን የሙስና ክሶች በመቃወም ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ስልጣን እንዲለቁ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ። ፖሊስ እንባ አቅራቢ ጋዝ፣ የውሃ መድፍ እና የጎማ ጥይቶችን በመጠቀም ሰልፈኞችን ለመበተን በመሞከሩ ብዙዎች መቁሰላቸው እና መታሰራቸው ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Magaalaa Tirana kan biyya Albaniyaa keessatti mormiin mootummaa mormu guyyaa shanaffaaf itti fufee jira. Barattoonni hedduun kan hirmaatan hiriirri kun, himata malaammaltummaa irratti hundaa'uun ministirri muummee akka aangoo gadi lakkisan gaafachaa jiru. Poolisoonni gaazii imimmaan fiduu fi humna fayyadamuun hiriiroota bittinneessuuf yaalii taasisaniin walitti bu'iinsa uumameen namoonni hedduun madaa'anii fi to'annoo jala oolaniiru.

title: At least 17 dead in crush at Hindu festival event in India
english: A deadly crowd crush occurred during a Durga Puja festival event in Kolkata, India, after sudden rainfall caused attendees to rush for cover. At least 17 people lost their lives, including a young child, while many others are currently being treated for injuries. Local authorities and national leaders have expressed deep sorrow, noting that overcrowding and safety management remain significant issues at large religious gatherings in the country.
amharic: በህንድ ኮልካታ ከተማ የዱርጋ ፑጃ የሃይማኖት በዓል እየተከበረ ባለበት ወቅት በድንገተኛ ዝናብ ምክንያት በተፈጠረ የሰዎች መጨናነቅ ቢያንስ 17 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በአደጋው ህፃናትን ጨምሮ ሌሎች በርካቶች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው ህክምና እየተደረገላቸው ይገኛል። እንደነዚህ ያሉ አሳዛኝ ክስተቶች በትላልቅ የሃይማኖት በዓላት ላይ የደህንነት ቁጥጥር ጉድለት ምክንያት በህንድ በተደጋጋሚ የሚከሰቱ ናቸው።
oromo: Indiyaa, magaalaa Kolkaataa keessatti ayyaana amantii Durgaa Puujaa irratti roobni tasa roobeen uummati bakka harka dhokfatuuf wal dhiituu uumameen lubbuun namoota 17 darbeera. Miidhaa kanaan daa'immanis dabalatee namoonni biroon hedduun madaa'anii yaalamaa jiru. Rakkooleen nageenyaa fi wal dhiituun gurguddaa ayyaana amantii irratti mudatuu kun Indiyaa keessatti rakkoo idilee ta'uu gabaasichi ni ibsa.

title: Photos: No Kings rallies in US urge midterm voters to cast ballots early
english: Thousands of people across the United States participated in 'No Kings' rallies this Saturday to encourage citizens to vote early in the upcoming midterm elections. While the events were presented as nonpartisan, they were driven by a movement critical of President Donald Trump’s administration. Organizers hope that promoting early voting will increase participation and prevent potential election-day issues or fraud.
amharic: በአሜሪካ በሚካሄደው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ዜጎች ቀደም ብለው ድምፃቸውን እንዲሰጡ ለማበረታታት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ቅዳሜ ዕለት በ'No Kings' ሰልፎች ላይ ተሳትፈዋል። ምንም እንኳን ዝግጅቶቹ ከፖለቲካ ወገንተኝነት ነጻ እንደሆኑ ቢገለጽም፣ የፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደርን የሚቃወመው ንቅናቄ አካል ናቸው። አዘጋጆቹ ቀደም ብሎ ድምጽ መስጠትን ማስተዋወቅ፣ የመራጮችን ተሳትፎ እንደሚጨምር እና የምርጫ ቀን ችግሮችን ወይም ማጭበርበርን ለመከላከል እንደሚረዳ ያምናሉ።
oromo: Guyyaa Sanbataa darbe biyyattii guutuu keessatti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman, filannoo giddu-galeessaatti namoonni akka duraa dursanii sagalee kennan jajjabeessuuf hiriira 'No Kings' jedhamu irratti hirmaataniiru. Hiriirichi garaagarummaa siyaasaa malee akka gaggeeffame kan ibsame ta'us, sochii mootummaa pirezidaant Donald Traamp mormuuf kan ka'e ture. Qindeessitoonni sagalee duraa kennuu jajjabeessuun, hirmaannaa uummataa akka dabaluufi rakkoolee guyyaa filannoo ykn sobaan walqabatanii mudachuu danda'an hir'isuuf gumaacha jedhanii amanu.

title: Cost of living protests hit Belgium, Italy, Portugal and France
english: Massive protests erupted across several European nations including France, Belgium, Italy, and Portugal as citizens demanded relief from the rising cost of living. Demonstrators are frustrated by economic hardships, such as soaring housing costs and stagnant wages, leading to clashes with police in multiple cities. Experts suggest that the unrest in France may be spreading, placing significant pressure on governments across the European Union to address these growing public grievances.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ፣ በቤልጂየም፣ በጣሊያን እና በፖርቹጋል የሚኖሩ በመቶ ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ዜጎች በኑሮ ውድነት ላይ ተቃውሞአቸውን ገልጸዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ እየጨመረ የመጣውን የቤት ኪራይ ዋጋ እና የደመወዝ መቀዛቀዝ በመቃወም በመዲናዎቻቸው ሰልፍ የወጡ ሲሆን፣ በአንዳንድ ቦታዎችም ከፖሊስ ጋር ግጭቶች ተፈጥረዋል። ይህ የተቃውሞ ማዕበል የአውሮፓ ህብረት መንግስታት በህዝቦቻቸው የኑሮ ሁኔታ ላይ ከፍተኛ ትኩረት እንዲሰጡ ጫና እያሳደረባቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Biyyoota Awurooppaa kanneen akka Faransaay, Beeljiyeem, Xaaliyaanii fi Poorchugaal keessatti, lammiileen gatiin jireenyaa dabaluu isaatti mormii guddaa dhageessisaniiru. Namoonni hedduun gatiin mana kireeffataa dabaluu fi mindaan gahaa ta'uu dhabuu isaatiin miidhamuu isaanii ibsachaa, magaalonni hedduunis hiriira mormii fi walitti bu'iinsa poolisii waliin walqabatu keessummeessaniiru. Sochiiwwan kun mootummoonni Gamtaa Awurooppaa rakkoo dinagdee ummataa furuuf dhiibbaa jabaa keessa akka galan taasiseera.

title: Ten killed in fire at beach resort in Bangladesh
english: A tragic fire at a beach resort in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh, has resulted in the deaths of ten people, including six members of one family. Officials revealed that the resort was operating illegally without the necessary fire safety permits. This incident occurred despite the establishment having received an official warning regarding its lack of safety measures earlier in June.
amharic: በባንግላዲሽ ኮክስ ባዛር በሚገኝ አንድ የባህር ዳርቻ መዝናኛ ቦታ በተነሳ የእሳት አደጋ ስድስት የቤተሰብ አባላትን ጨምሮ አስር ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ባለሥልጣናት እንደገለጹት፣ መዝናኛው የእሳት አደጋ መከላከያ ፈቃድ ሳይኖረው በሕገ-ወጥ መንገድ ሲንቀሳቀስ እንደነበር ተጋልጧል። ተቋሙ ቀደም ሲል በሰኔ ወር የደህንነት ጉድለት እንዳለበት ማስጠንቀቂያ ተሰጥቶት የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ አደጋው ሊከሰት ችሏል።
oromo: Bangladesh, Cox’s Bazar keessatti bakka boqonnaa qarqara galaanaatti ibiddi ka’e lubbuu namoota kudhanii galaafateera; isaan keessaa ja’a maatii tokko keessaa ti. Qondaalonni akka ibsanitti, bakki boqonnaa kun hayyama nageenyaa ibiddarraa ittisuu malee seeraan ala hojjetaa ture. Dhaabbatichi ji’a Waxabajjii darbe keessa rakkoo nageenyaa qabaachuu isaatiin akeekkachiisni kennameefii ture.

title: Protesters allege police brutality as violent clashes rage on in Albania
english: Violent protests have continued in Albania for five consecutive days as thousands of citizens gather to call for the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama. Tensions escalated into clashes outside the Ministry of Education, where demonstrators accused the police of using excessive force. The situation remains unstable as the public continues to voice their grievances against the current government.
amharic: በአልባኒያ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኤዲ ራማ ስልጣናቸውን እንዲለቁ በመጠየቅ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ዜጎች ለቀናት የዘለቀ ተቃውሞ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ። በትምህርት ሚኒስቴር መስሪያ ቤት አቅራቢያ በተፈጠረው ግጭት ተቃዋሚዎች በፖሊስ ላይ የጭካኔ ድርጊት ፈጽመዋል ሲሉ ከሰዋል። የሀገሪቱ የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ አሁንም ውጥረት ውስጥ ይገኛል።
oromo: Albaaniyaa keessatti mormiin guyyaa shanaffaadhaaf itti fufee kan jiru yoo ta'u, namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman ministira muummee Eedii Raamaa aangoo gadhiisuu qabu jechuun hiriira bahaniiru. Kutaalee magaalaa keessatti waldhabdee uumameen mormitoonni poolisiin humna guutummaatti akka fayyadame himataniiru. Haalli biyyattii amma illee waldhabdee keessa jira.

title: Al Jazeera reporter harassed, struck on head amid France protests, looting
english: Al Jazeera journalist Rosie Birchard was attacked while covering nationwide protests in Rennes, France. She experienced harassment from individuals looting local businesses and sustained a head injury after being hit by a thrown object. These demonstrations, which focus on concerns over education and the rising cost of living, have resulted in widespread violence and chaos across various French cities.
amharic: የአልጀዚራ ጋዜጠኛ ሮዚ ቢርቻርድ በፈረንሳይ ረኔ ከተማ ተቃውሞን በዘገበችበት ወቅት ጥቃት ደርሶባታል። በዘረፋ ላይ የነበሩ ተቃዋሚዎች ጋዜጠኛዋን በማወክ እና በወረወሩት ነገር ጭንቅላቷን በመምታት ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። በትምህርት እና በኑሮ ውድነት ላይ ያተኮሩት እነዚህ ተቃውሞዎች በመላው ፈረንሳይ ወደ ግጭት እና ሁከት ተቀይረዋል።
oromo: Gaazexeessituun Al-Jazeera Rozi Birchaard biyya Faransaay magaalaa Reennesitti yeroo gabaasaa turteetti miidhaan irra ga'eera. Namoonni suuqii saamachaa turan gaazexeessittii kana dararuu fi meeshaa darbataniin mataa ishee rukutuun madaa'eetti. Sagantaan mormii kanneen barattootaa fi gatii jireenyaa irratti xiyyeeffatan kunneen, biyyattii keessatti gara jeequmsaa fi walitti bu'iinsatti jijjiirameera.

title: Riyadh residents warned of ‘hostile aerial threat’ as Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi missiles
english: Residents in Riyadh received an emergency alert warning them of a potential aerial attack on Sunday morning. The Saudi-led coalition confirmed that two missiles launched by Houthi forces toward the Yemeni border were successfully intercepted. Authorities later announced that the threat had been neutralized and it is now safe for residents in the affected areas.
amharic: የሪያድ ነዋሪዎች እሁድ ማለዳ ላይ ሊደርስ የሚችል የአየር ጥቃትን አስመልክቶ የድንገተኛ ማስጠንቀቂያ መልእክት ደርሷቸዋል። የሳውዲ ጥምር ኃይል በየመን ድንበር አቅራቢያ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የተተኮሱ ሁለት ሚሳኤሎች በተሳካ ሁኔታ መመታታቸውን አስታውቋል። ባለስልጣናት ስጋቱ መወገዱን በመግለጽ ሁኔታው ወደ መደበኛው መመለሱን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: jiraattonni magaala Riyaad Dilbata ganama ergaa akeekkachiisaa haleellaa qilleensa irraa dhufuu danda'u ilaalchisee bilbila isaaniitiin qaqqabeera. Paartiin bulchiinsa Sa'udii hogganamu, meeshaan waraanaa lama kan garee Huutii biyya Yemen irraa gara daangaa Sa'uditti dhukaafaman qilleensa keessatti akka barbadeessaman ibseera. Yeroo ammaa balaan kun darbee nageenyi waan mirkanaa'eef jiraattonni tasgabbaa'anii akka turan eerameera.

title: Netanyahu says 'smear' campaign targeting settlers as attack on French mayor draws condemnation
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu claims a coordinated smear campaign is being waged against settlers following an assault on a French mayor in the West Bank. While Netanyahu criticized the mayor's political background and the lack of military coordination, the violence has faced widespread international condemnation. Furthermore, U.S. Ambassador Mike Huckabee has demanded the prosecution of settlers who recently attacked a Washington Post journalist, labeling the assault a cowardly act of terror.
amharic: በምዕራብ ባንክ የፈረንሳይ ከንቲባ ላይ በደረሰ ጥቃት ተከትሎ፣ የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በሰፋሪዎች ላይ የተቀናጀ የጥላቻ ዘመቻ እየተካሄደ ነው ሲሉ ከሰዋል። ኔታንያሁ የከንቲባውን የፖለቲካ አቋም በመተቸት ክስተቱን ለመከላከል ቢሞክሩም፣ ድርጊቱ ከፍተኛ ዓለም አቀፍ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም የአሜሪካው አምባሳደር ማይክ ሃካቢ በቅርቡ በዋሽንግተን ፖስት ጋዜጠኛ ላይ ጥቃት የፈጸሙ ሰፋሪዎች በህግ እንዲጠየቁ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministira Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahu, gandoota isaanirratti duulli qindaa'een gadi-qabaa fi xureessuu adeemsifamaa jiraachuu himan; kunis kan ta'e erga namoonni gandoota keessa jiraatan kaantibaa Faransaay tokko irratti weerara raawwatanii booda. Netanyaahuu haala kanaan walqabatee rakkoolee siyaasaa fi qindoomina dhabuu himatanis, gochi kun mormii idil-addunyaa cimaa isa mudateera. Gama biraatiin, Ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa Maayik Haakabii garee gaazexeessituu 'Washington Post' irratti haleellaa raawwataniin seeratti akka dhiyaatan gaafataniiru.

title: France demands Israel arrest settlers who attacked French mayor in West Bank
english: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot has called on Israel to hold accountable the extremist settlers who physically attacked Bernard Baudoux, the mayor of Aulnoye-Aymeries, in the West Bank. The 78-year-old mayor was visiting a Palestinian village with European diplomats to observe olive harvesting when he was beaten with iron bars and kicked. France is now demanding that Israeli authorities ensure the safety of civilians and bring those responsible for the violence to justice according to international law.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ዣን-ኖኤል ባሮት በዌስት ባንክ የፈረንሳይ ከተማ ከንቲባ በርናርድ ባውዶክስ ላይ ጥቃት ያደረሱ አክራሪ ሰፋሪዎች ተጠያቂ እንዲሆኑ እስራኤልን ጠየቁ። የ78 ዓመቱ ከንቲባ ከአውሮፓ ዲፕሎማቶች ጋር በመሆን በዌስት ባንክ የዘይቱን ምርት ለማየት በሄዱበት ወቅት በቡድን በተደራጁ ሰፋሪዎች ተደብድበዋል። ፈረንሳይ እስራኤል በዓለም አቀፍ ህግ መሰረት የሲቪሎችን ደህንነት እንድትጠብቅ እና ጥቃት አድራሾቹን ለፍርድ እንድታቀርብ አሳስባለች።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Faransaay Jean-Noel Barrot, godina 'West Bank' keessatti kantiibaa magaalaa Aulnoye-Aymeries, Bernard Baudoux irratti miidhaa qaqqabsiisaniif akkaatuma seeraatiin akka itti gaafatamaniif mootummaa Israa'el gaafatan. Kantiibaan umriin isaanii 78 kun, dippiloomatoota Awurooppaa waliin ta'uun oomisha ejersaa daawwachuuf gara ganda Paalastayinii tokkoo yeroo deemanitti garee namoota hidhataniin rukutamanii miidhamaniiru. Faransaay, Israa'el seera idil-addunyaa kabajchuun nageenya namoota nagaa akka eegduu fi yakka kana raawwatan irratti tarkaanfii fudhattu akkaataa seeraatiin gaafatteetti.

title: Lebanon to join trilateral talks with Israel and US in Florida next week, Aoun says
english: Lebanon plans to send a military delegation to Florida next week for US-supported talks with Israel to address rising regional tensions. President Aoun expressed frustration that Israel has not upheld the previously agreed-upon framework and is pushing for a solution to stop further escalation. Additionally, Lebanon is requesting to extend the UN peacekeeping mission's presence in the south until 2027 to maintain stability and prevent direct military confrontations.
amharic: ሊባኖስ በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ግጭት ለመፍታት በሚቀጥለው ሳምንት በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ ከእስራኤል ጋር በሚደረግ የሶስትዮሽ ውይይት ለመሳተፍ ወታደራዊ ልዑክ ወደ ፍሎሪዳ ለመላክ አቅዳለች። ፕሬዚዳንት አውን እስራኤል ከዚህ ቀደም የተስማሙበትን የሰላም ማዕቀፍ ባለማክበሯ ቅር መሰኘታቸውን ገልጸው፣ ግጭትን የሚያቆም መፍትሄ እንዲፈለግ አሳስበዋል። እንዲሁም፣ በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ ያለው የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይል በክልሉ መረጋጋትን እንዲጠብቅና ቀጥተኛ ግጭትን እንዲከላከል ስልጣኑ እስከ 2027 እንዲራዘም ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Libanoon waldhabdee naannichatti dabalaa jiru furuuf jecha, torbaan dhufu magaala Florida keessatti marii sadan waliin ta'ee Israa'elii fi Ameerikaa waliin taasisuuf garee waraanaa erguuf qophoofteetti. Preezidaanti Aawun, Israa'el walii galtee kanaan dura irra ga'ame kabajuu dhabuu ishiitti gadda guddaa ibsuun, guutummaa guututti tarkaanfii waraanaa dhaabuuf gaaffii dhiyeessaniiru. Kana malees, nageenya naannichaatti eeguufi walitti bu'iinsa kallattii waraanaa ittisuuf jecha, ergamni waraana naga eegduu tokkummaa mootummootaa hanga bara 2027tti akka dheeratu gaafataniiru.

title: Six Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes across Gaza in a day
english: Israeli military operations throughout the Gaza Strip resulted in the deaths of six Palestinians on Saturday. One of the incidents involved a drone strike that targeted a group of people near the Jabalia refugee camp, leaving one man dead and several others injured. Medical officials confirmed that these casualties occurred as part of a series of attacks that took place throughout the day.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ዕለት በጋዛ ሰርጥ በተፈጸሙ የእስራኤል ጥቃቶች ስድስት ፍልስጤማውያን ተገድለዋል። ከእነዚህ ጥቃቶች መካከል በጀባሊያ የስደተኞች ካምፕ አቅራቢያ በድሮን የታገዘ ጥቃት አንድ ወጣት ሲገደል ሌሎች በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። የህክምና ባለሙያዎች እንዳረጋገጡት፣ እነዚህ የሞት አደጋዎች የተከሰቱት በዕለቱ በተካሄዱ ተከታታይ የጦር መሳሪያ ድብደባዎች ሳቢያ ነው።
oromo: Guyyaa Sanbataa weerara Israa'el ganda Gaaza keessatti raawwatameen namoonni Filiisxeemii ja'a du'aniiru. Hojiilee waraanaa kanaan duula diroonii qubata baqattootaa Jabaaliyaa cinaatti raawwatameen dargaggeessi tokko ajjeefamee kanneen biroon hedduun madaa'aniiru. Ogeeyyiin fayyaa akka mirkaneessanitti, namoonni kunneen guyyaa guutuu hiriira weeraraa gaggeeffameen lubbuun isaanii darbeera.

title: Israeli drone attacks kill six Palestinians across Gaza despite ‘ceasefire’
english: Israeli drone strikes have killed six Palestinians in various parts of the Gaza Strip, continuing the violence despite a long-standing ceasefire agreement. Reports indicate these attacks hit civilian areas in the north, center, and south of Gaza. According to the Gaza Health Ministry and UNICEF, thousands have been killed and hundreds of children have lost their lives since the supposed ceasefire began a year ago.
amharic: የእስራኤል ድሮኖች በጋዛ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ባደረሱት ጥቃት ስድስት ፍልስጤማውያን ተገድለዋል። የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ቢኖርም፣ ጥቃቶቹ በሰሜን፣ በመሀል እና በደቡብ ጋዛ በሚገኙ የሲቪል መኖሪያዎች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ናቸው። የጋዛ ጤና ሚኒስቴር እና የተባበሩት መንግስታት የህጻናት መርጃ ድርጅት (ዩኒሴፍ) እንደገለጹት፣ ከአንድ አመት በፊት ከተባለው የተኩስ አቁም በኋላ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ተገድለው ከነዚህም መካከል በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ህጻናት ይገኙበታል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el gaazaa keessatti haleellaa xiyyaaraa kanaan nama jaha ajjeeseera, kunis waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa dura erga irra ga'amee booda itti fufee jira. Haleellaan kun bakkeewwan garagaraa kanneen akka kaabaa, giddugaleessaa fi kibba Gaazaa keessatti namoota nagaa irratti kan raawwatame dha. Ministeerri fayyaa Gaazaa fi dhaabbanni UNICEF akka ibsanitti, waggaa tokko dura dhaabbii waraanaa labsame sana booda namoonni kumaatamaan lakka'aman ajjeefamanii, ijoolleen dhibbaan lakka'amanis lubbuun isaanii darbeera.

title: India and West Indies denied a thrilling finale as rain hits final T20
english: The final T20 cricket match between India and the West Indies ended in a draw after heavy rain forced the game to be abandoned. Although the match was shortened to nine overs, persistent bad weather prevented a result, leaving the five-game series tied at 2-2. Despite the disappointment, Indian batters provided an exciting performance before the match was officially called off.
amharic: በህንድ እና በዌስት ኢንዲስ መካከል ሲደረግ የነበረው የመጨረሻው የቲ-20 የክሪኬት ጨዋታ በከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት ሳይጠናቀቅ በዝናብ ተስተጓጉሏል። ጨዋታው ወደ ዘጠኝ ኦቨር እንዲቀንስ ቢደረግም፣ ዝናቡ ባለማቆሙ የሁለቱ ቡድኖች ተከታታይ ጨዋታ በአቻ ውጤት 2 ለ 2 ተጠናቋል። ጨዋታው ከመሰረዙ በፊት የህንድ ተጫዋቾች ጥሩ እንቅስቃሴ አሳይተው ነበር።
oromo: Taphi kubbaa miilaa (T20) isa dhumaa kan Hindii fi Westi Indiis gidduutti taasifamaa ture, rooba cimaan waan dhufeef xumura malee addaan cite. Tapha kana gara ooverii sagaliitti gadi buusuun yaalamee kan ture ta'us, roobni hammaatee waan itti fufeef taphichi moo'ataa tokko malee qixxee 2 fi 2 ta'uun xumurameera. Taphichi osoo hin addaan batin dura, taphattoonni Hindii hawwataa ta'e taphachaa turan.

title: Pope Leo returns to Vatican after lung cancer surgery
english: Pope Leo has been discharged from a Rome hospital after undergoing successful surgery to remove a cancerous tumor from his lung. Medical professionals report that he is recovering well, and the Pope plans to return to his public duties starting this Sunday. He is currently preparing for a demanding international trip to Latin America scheduled for mid-November.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ ከሳንባ ካንሰር ቀዶ ጥገና በኋላ ከሆስፒታል ወጥተው ወደ ቫቲካን ተመልሰዋል። የሕክምና ባለሙያዎች የጤና ሁኔታቸው እየተሻሻለ መሆኑን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳቱ በመጪው እሁድ የሥራ ኃላፊነታቸውን እንደሚጀምሩ ይጠበቃል። በህዳር ወር አጋማሽ ወደ ላቲን አሜሪካ የሚያደርጉትን ጉዞ ለማከናወን ዝግጅት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Paaphaas Leo erga somba isaanii irratti baqaqaa kaansarii baasanii booda hospitaala irraa gara Vaatikaanitti deebi'aniiru. Ogeeyyiin fayyaa fayyummaan isaanii fooyya'aa akka jiru ibsaniiru, akkasumas Dilbata dhufu hojiiwwan isaanii kan itti fufan ta'uu beekameera. Paaphaasichi ji'a Sadaasaa keessa gara biyyoota Laatiin Ameerikaatti imala barbaachisaa ta'e gochuuf qophiirra jiru.

title: Trump faces bipartisan backlash over Russia sanctions waiver
english: President Donald Trump is facing strong criticism from both major political parties for suspending sanctions on Russia and countries purchasing its energy. Although Trump signed the law requiring these penalties just last month, he recently issued an executive order to waive them indefinitely, citing national interest. Lawmakers from both sides argue this decision undermines support for Ukraine and disrespects the clear mandate established by Congress.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሩሲያ እና የሩሲያን ነዳጅ በሚገዙ ሀገራት ላይ ሊጣል የነበረውን ማዕቀብ በማገድ በሁለቱም የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል። ትራምፕ ባለፈው ወር ማዕቀቡን የሚያጸድቅ ህግ ቢፈርሙም፣ በቅርቡ ባወጡት የአስፈጻሚ ትዕዛዝ ብሄራዊ ጥቅምን መሠረት በማድረግ ማዕቀቡ ላልተወሰነ ጊዜ እንዲራዘም አድርገዋል። የሁለቱም ወገን ህግ አውጪዎች ይህ ውሳኔ የዩክሬንን ድጋፍ የሚጎዳ እና የኮንግረስን ውሳኔ ችላ የሚል ነው በማለት ይተቻሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Donald Traamp maallaqa adabaa biyyoota Raashiyaarraa boba'aa bitanirratti kaa'amee ture sababa 'faayidaa biyyaa' jedhuun dhaabuun isaanii, miseensota paartilee lamaanuu biratti mormii guddaa kaaseera. Traamp ji'a darbe qofa seera adaba kana irratti mallatteessanii turanillee, amma garuu ajaja tokkoon adabichaa yeroo hin murtoofneef fannisuuf murteessaniiru. Miseensonni Kongirasii mormitootaa fi gartuu Traamp keessaa, murtiin kun deeggarsa Yuukireeniif qabnu kan laaffisuu fi kabaja seera baastuu ta'e kan cabsuudha jechuun balaaleffatan.

title: Jerusalem Daily: Israeli settlers attack farmers and journalists
english: Israeli settlers recently carried out violent attacks against Palestinian farmers and a Washington Post reporter in the occupied West Bank. These assaults occurred during the ongoing olive harvest season. This incident highlights the persistent issue of settler violence affecting civilians and the media in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ውስጥ በፓለስቲናውያን ገበሬዎች እና በአንድ የዋሽንግተን ፖስት ጋዜጠኛ ላይ ጥቃት አድርሰዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈፀመው የዘይቱን ምርት በሚሰበስቡበት ወቅት ነው። ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ ውስጥ በሲቪል ህዝብ እና በጋዜጠኞች ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን የሰፈራ ሰሪዎች ጥቃት አጠናክሮ ያሳያል።
oromo: Warra biyya lafaa qabatanii jiraatan (settlers) kan Israa'el, naannoo West Bank keessatti qoteebulaa Palestiinii fi gaazexeessaa 'Washington Post' tokko irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo midhaan ejersaa haamaa jiranitti dha. Gochi kun rakkoo haleellaa fi doorsisaa namoota nagaa fi miidiyaalee irratti naannichatti yeroo dheeraaf mul'atu kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Nursery owner in China jailed for life after hundreds of children poisoned
english: A Chinese nursery owner and five staff members received prison sentences after poisoning over 200 children with lead-tainted food. The school administration had ordered the kitchen staff to use toxic paint on meals to improve their appearance and attract more students. The lead levels in the food were found to be thousands of times higher than safety limits, leading to severe health risks for the pupils.
amharic: በቻይና የሚገኝ አንድ የህፃናት ማቆያ ባለቤት እና አምስት ሰራተኞች ከ200 በላይ ህፃናትን በመርዝ መመረዛቸውን ተከትሎ በእስር እንዲቀጡ ተወስኖባቸዋል። ትምህርት ቤቱ ተማሪዎችን ለመሳብ ሲባል ምግቦቹ የተሻለ እንዲታዩ መርዛማ ቀለም እንዲጠቀሙ ለወጥ ቤት ሰራተኞች ትእዛዝ ሰጥቶ ነበር። በምግብ ውስጥ የተገኘው የሊድ መጠን ከደህንነት ጣሪያው በሺህ የሚቆጠር እጥፍ በላይ በመሆኑ በህፃናቱ ጤና ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሷል።
oromo: Abbaan qabeenyaa manneen barnoota ijoollee xixiqqoo tokkoo fi hojjettoonni isaa shan, ijoollee 200 ol ta'an nyaata summaa'e keemikaala 'lead' jedhamuun wal qabatee erga dhukkubsanii booda hidhaa waggaa dheeraa itti murteeffameera. Manneen barnootichaa ijoollee baay'ee harkisuuf jecha nyaata isaanii halluu namatti toluuf jedhanii keemikaala summaa'aa akka itti fayyadaman hojjettoota isaanii ajajuun isaanii beekameera. Nyaatawwan kun akkaataa qajeelfama fayyaa biyyattii irraa dachaa kumaan lakkaa'amuun summaa'ee waan argameef, ijoolleen kunneen miidhaa cimaa fayyaa keessa galaniiru.

title: Buildings and cars set on fire as cost of living protests rock France
english: France is currently experiencing widespread violent protests as citizens voice their frustration over the rising cost of living and the deterioration of public services. Demonstrators have caused significant destruction, including burning vehicles and buildings, in Paris and several other regions across the country. The situation remains volatile as the government faces mounting pressure from these nationwide displays of public anger.
amharic: የኑሮ ውድነትን እና የመንግስት አገልግሎቶች መዳከምን በመቃወም በፈረንሳይ ሀገር አቀፍ ተቃውሞዎች ተቀስቅሰዋል። በፓሪስ እና በተለያዩ የፈረንሳይ ከተሞች ተቃዋሚዎች ህንጻዎችን እና ተሽከርካሪዎችን በማቃጠል ከፍተኛ ሁከት እየፈጠሩ ይገኛሉ። የህዝቡ ቁጣ እየተባባሰ በመሄዱ በሀገሪቱ ያለው ሁኔታ ውጥረት ውስጥ ይገኛል።
oromo: Faransaatti qaalii jireenyaa fi rakkoo tajaajila mootummaa mormuun hiriirri gurguddaan guutuu biyyattii keessatti adeemsifamaa jira. Balaan fi mormiin kun hammaachaa waan jiruuf, mootummaan Faransaas yaaddoo cimaa keessa galtee jirti.

title: Pope Leo leaves hospital after lung cancer surgery
english: Pope Leo has been discharged from a Rome hospital following a successful operation to remove lung cancer. He appeared in good condition and was able to walk without assistance while greeting supporters. The Pope is planning to resume his public duties, including leading Sunday prayers, as medical professionals continue to monitor his recovery.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ የሳንባ ካንሰር ቀዶ ጥገናቸው ከተሳካ በኋላ ከሮም ሆስፒታል ወጥተዋል። በሆስፒታሉ ቆይታቸው ወቅት በጥሩ ሁኔታ ላይ የነበሩ ሲሆን፣ ምንም ድጋፍ ሳይፈልጉ በእግራቸው በመራመድ ደጋፊዎቻቸውን ሰላምታ ሰጥተዋል። ጳጳሱ የጤና ሁኔታቸው እየተሻሻለ በመምጣቱ በእሁዱ የጸሎት መርሃ ግብር ላይ ለመገኘት ዝግጅታቸውን አጠናቀዋል።
oromo: Paappaas Liyoos baqaqaa sombaa erga kolleejjii fayyaa Room keessatti baqachiifatanii booda gara mana isaanii deebi'aniiru. Innis haala gaarii keessa kan jiran yoo ta'u, deeggarsa tokko malee ofiin deemanii namoota isa simatanis haasofsiisaniiru. Paappaasichi Dilbata dhufu sagantaa kadhannaa geggeessuuf karoorfatanii jiru, yeroo sanatti ogeeyyonni fayyaas haala fayyaa isaanii hordofuu itti fufu.

title: Neto’s brace fires Chelsea past Everton but Martinez head injury mars win
english: Chelsea secured a 2-0 victory against Everton thanks to two goals from Pedro Neto, marking their first away win and clean sheet of the season. The match was overshadowed by a serious head injury to Chelsea goalkeeper Emi Martinez, who was sent to the hospital for precautionary tests following a collision. Despite a physical and intense game, the win moved Chelsea into the top four of the Premier League standings.
amharic: ፔድሮ ኔቶ ባስቆጠራቸው ሁለት ግቦች ቼልሲ ኤቨርተንን 2-0 በማሸነፍ የውድድር ዘመኑን የመጀመሪያ የሜዳ ውጪ ድል እና ንጹህ መረብ አስመዝግቧል። ሆኖም የቼልሲው ግብ ጠባቂ ኤሚ ማርቲኔዝ ከኤቨርተኑ ተጫዋች ጋር በተጋጨበት ወቅት በደረሰበት ጉዳት ምክንያት ወደ ሆስፒታል በመላኩ ጨዋታው በስጋት ታጅቦ ነበር። ይህ ውጤት ቼልሲን በፕሪሚየር ሊጉ የደረጃ ሰንጠረዥ አራቱ ውስጥ እንዲገባ አስችሎታል።

title: Ilhan Omar’s lawyers demand the return of property seized in house raid
english: Lawyers for US Representative Ilhan Omar are demanding the return of items seized during a federal raid on her home, arguing the search was politically motivated and legally flawed. The legal team contends that investigators ignored specific judicial instructions meant to protect the constitutional rights of a sitting member of Congress. They further claim that the probe into her immigration history is baseless and inappropriate, especially given its timing just before the midterm elections.

oromo: Abukaatonni miseensa mana maree bakka buutota ummataa US Ilhaan Oomar, qabeenya mana isaanii keessaa humnoota federaalaan fudhatame akka deebi'u gaafatan. Qorannoon seenaa godaantotaa ishee irratti taasifamus bu'uura kan hin qabneefi yeroo filannoo gannaa wajjin walqabatee kan dhufe ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Thousands rally for biggest protest in years against Tunisia’s Saied
english: Thousands of Tunisians recently gathered in the capital to protest against President Kais Saied, marking the largest demonstration against his leadership in years. Organized by major labor unions and opposition groups, the rally highlighted growing public anger over severe economic hardships and the erosion of political freedoms. Protesters demanded the release of political detainees and expressed deep frustration regarding the rising cost of living and frequent shortages of essential goods.
amharic: በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የቱኒዚያ ዜጎች በፕሬዝዳንት ካይስ ሰኢድ አስተዳደር ላይ ተቃውሞ ለማሰማት በዋና ከተማዋ ሰልፍ ወጥተዋል። በዋና ዋና የሠራተኛ ማህበራት እና በተቃዋሚ ፓርቲዎች የተመራው ይህ ሰልፍ፣ በአገሪቱ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የኑሮ ውድነት እና የፖለቲካ ነፃነቶች መገደብ በመቃወም የተካሄደ ነው። ተቃዋሚዎቹ በፖለቲካ ምክንያት የታሰሩ እንዲፈቱ እንዲሁም በመንግስት ላይ ያላቸውን ቅሬታ በሰፊው ገልጸዋል።

Hiriirtoonni kunniin namoonni sababa siyaasaan hidhaman akka gadhiifaman gaafachuu fi gatiin meeshaalee gurguddaa dabuu isaa balaaleeffataniiru.

title: Rare pink diamond goes on display in France 100 years after amateur heist
english: A rare nine-carat pink diamond known as the Grand Condé is being exhibited in France, marking its first public display since a famous 1926 theft. The historical gem was originally stolen and hidden inside an apple, only to be recovered after a maid accidentally bit into the fruit. It will remain on display at the Château de Chantilly through January 3, featuring newly revealed historical archives about its mysterious past.
amharic: ግራንድ ኮንዴ በመባል የሚታወቀው ብርቅዬ የዘጠኝ ካራት ሮዝ አልማዝ፣ በ1926 ከተሰረቀ በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በፈረንሳይ ለሕዝብ ዕይታ ቀርቧል። ይህ ታሪካዊ ዕንቁ ቀደም ሲል ተሰርቆ በፖም ውስጥ ተደብቆ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ የሆቴል ሰራተኛ በአጋጣሚ ፖምዋን ስትነክስ ሊገኝ ችሏል። አልማዙ እስከ ጥር 3 ቀን ድረስ በሻቶ ደ ሻንቲሊ ሙዚየም የሚቆይ ሲሆን፣ ጎብኝዎች ስለ ታሪኩ የሚያወሱ አዳዲስ መረጃዎችንም መመልከት ይችላሉ።
oromo: Alimaaziin roozaa baay'ee xiqqoo ta'ee fi 'Grand Condé' jedhamu, bara 1926 erga hatamee booda yeroo jalqabaaf Faransaay keessatti mul'achuu jalqabeera. title: Child, four women among Palestinians injured in West Bank pogroms
english: Israeli settlers and military forces have launched a series of violent attacks against Palestinians across the occupied West Bank during the olive harvest season. These assaults, which included shootings and property destruction, resulted in several injuries, including those of a child and four women. The violence follows a controversial religious edict that encourages the seizure of Palestinian olive crops, further restricting farmers from accessing their own land.

title: Davidovich Fokina stuns top seed Zverev to reach Shanghai Masters final
english: Alejandro Davidovich Fokina pulled off a major upset by defeating top-seeded Alexander Zverev in a three-set match to reach the Shanghai Masters final. Despite losing the opening set, the Spaniard fought back to win, showcasing strong performance and physical endurance. He now advances to the championship round, where he will compete against either Daniil Medvedev or Rafael Jodar.
amharic: አሌሃንድሮ ዳቪዶቪች ፎኪና በሻንጋይ ማስተርስ የፍጻሜ ጨዋታ ለመድረስ ቀዳሚውን ተወዳዳሪ አሌክሳንደር ዝቬሬቭን በመርታት አስገራሚ ድል አስመዝግቧል። ስፓኒሽ ተጫዋቹ የመጀመሪያውን ዙር ሽንፈት ቢገጥመውም፣ በጽናት በመታገል የጨዋታውን ውጤት ቀልብሶ አሸንፏል። አሁን በውድድሩ የፍጻሜ ጨዋታ ላይ ከዳኒል ሜድቬዴቭ ወይም ከራፋኤል ጆዳር ጋር የሚገናኝ ይሆናል።
oromo: Alehandiro Daavidovich Fookiinaan taphata duraa fi biyyaatti cimaa kan ta'e Aleksaandar Zveerev injifachuun xumura tapha Shaanghaay Maastersirra ga'eera. title: Hardline Israeli rabbi ruling on stolen Palestinian olives prompts uproar
english: A prominent Israeli rabbi, Dov Lior, has sparked outrage by issuing a religious decree that encourages settlers to steal olives from Palestinian farms in the West Bank. The ruling claims that seizing these crops is a righteous act of reclaiming land that he asserts belongs to Jewish people. This controversial guidance has coincided with a surge in violent attacks by settlers against Palestinian farmers during the current harvest season.
amharic: ታዋቂው የእስራኤል ረቢ ዶቭ ሊዮር በአይሁድ ሰፋሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ የሚገኙ የፍልስጤማውያን የወይራ እርሻዎችን መዝረፍ እንደሚቻል የሚገልጽ ሃይማኖታዊ ድንጋጌ በማስተላለፋቸው ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል። ረቢው ይህ ድርጊት የተሰረቀ መሬትን መልሶ ለመውሰድ የሚደረግ ትክክለኛ ተግባር እንደሆነ ይከራከራሉ። ይህ ውሳኔ በወይራ ምርት ወቅት በአርሶ አደሮች ላይ እየደረሰ ካለው ጥቃት ጋር ተያይዞ ውጥረቱን አባብሶታል።
oromo: Rabbiin Israa'el beekamaan Dov Lior, qonnaan bultoota Falastiin kan naannoo Lixaa (West Bank) irraa ejersa hatuun akka hayyamamu labsuun isaa mormii cimaa uumeera. Rabbiin kun gochi kun lafa 'kan keenya' jedhan deeffachuuf tarkaanfii qajeelaa akka ta'e dubbatu. Murteen kun yeroo haamilaa kanatti haleellaa qonnaan bultoota Falastiin irratti raawwatamu daran hammaachiseera.

title: France tackles new wave of nationwide protests
english: France is facing widespread demonstrations as students, labor unions, and activist groups take to the streets to protest rising costs of living and social inequality. Officials are concerned about the situation, noting that recent rallies have turned into some of the most violent confrontations the country has seen in years. The government remains on high alert as these protests continue to disrupt the nation.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ እየጨመረ በመጣው የኑሮ ውድነት እና ማህበራዊ አለመመጣጠን የተነሳ በተማሪዎች፣ በሰራተኛ ማህበራት እና በተለያዩ ተቃዋሚ ቡድኖች የሚመራ ሰፊ ህዝባዊ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟታል። ባለስልጣናት በቅርብ ጊዜ የታዩት ግጭቶች ከበርካታ አሥርተ ዓመታት ወዲህ ከተከሰቱት ሁሉ የከፉ በመሆናቸው ለጸጥታው እጅግ ተጨንቀዋል። ተቃውሞው በመቀጠሉ መንግስት ከፍተኛ ጥንቃቄ እያደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Faransaay keessatti barattoonni, gamtaaleen hojjettootaa fi gareewwan mormituu gatii gabaa fi wal-qixxummaa dhabuu mormuudhaan hiriira guddaa gaggeessaa jiru. Abbootiin taayitaa biyyattii, mormiin yeroo dhihoo kana mul'ate kun walitti bu'iinsa cimaa fi waggoota dheeraaf biyyattii keessatti hin argamin kan uume ta'uu isaa ibsuun yaaddoo qabu. Mormiin kun itti fufuun isaa mootummaan akka of eeggannoo cimaa godhu isa dirqisiiseera.

title: US and Iran both claim control of Strait of Hormuz amid attacks on vessels
english: Tensions in the Strait of Hormuz have escalated, with both the United States and Iran attempting to assert dominance over the vital waterway amid a surge in ship attacks. Maritime authorities report that numerous vessels have been struck by naval mines and other weapons this month, causing significant disruptions to international oil flows. Consequently, global energy prices have spiked as the ongoing conflict makes the region increasingly dangerous for commercial shipping.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ አካባቢ በተደጋጋሚ በመርከቦች ላይ ጥቃት እየተፈጸመ በመሆኑ በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ውጥረት አድጓል። ሁለቱም ሀገራት ይህንን ወሳኝ የንግድ መስመር ለመቆጣጠር እየሞከሩ ሲሆን፣ ይህም አለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ አቅርቦትን በእጅጉ እያስተጓጎለ ይገኛል። በዚህ የተነሳ በክልሉ ያለው የደህንነት ሁኔታ በመባባሱ የነዳጅ ዋጋ በአለም ገበያ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጭማሪ አሳይቷል።
oromo: Naannoo daandii bishaan galaana Hormuzitti haleellaan dooniiwwan irratti raawwatamu dabaluun wal-dhabdee Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru hammaachiseera. Biyyoonni lamaanuu karaa seera qabeessa ta'e kanatti fayyadamuuf wal dorgomaa waan jiraniif, geejjibni boba'aa addunyaa miidhaa cimaaf saaxilameera. Haala kanaan wal qabatee, nageenyi naannichaa waan hir'ateef gatiin boba'aa gabaa addunyaa irratti dabaluun isaa beekameera.

title: Five Palestinians killed by Israel in Gaza
english: Five Palestinians have died following a series of Israeli drone strikes in the Gaza Strip. The casualties occurred in separate incidents, including an attack on a vehicle located in Rafah. Emergency responders confirmed the deaths occurred over the course of a single day.
amharic: በጋዛ ሰርጥ በተፈጸሙ ተከታታይ የእስራኤል ድሮን ጥቃቶች አምስት ፍልስጤማውያን ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ከሟቾቹ መካከል በአንድ የተሽከርካሪ ጥቃት የተገደሉ እና የቆሰሉ ሰዎች ይገኙበታል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች አምስቱም ግለሰቦች በተለያዩ የጥቃት ክስተቶች መሞታቸውን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Gaza keessatti weerara xiyyaara malee (drone) Israa'el raawwateen namoonni Falasxiin shan lubbuun darbaniiru. Kanneen keessaa tokko magaalaa Raafah keessatti konkolaataa irratti erga weeraramee booda du'e. Tajaajiltoonni hatattamaa akka ibsanitti, miidhaan kun guyyaa tokko keessatti bakka gara garaatti mudate.

title: IRGC declares Strait of Hormuz closed after tankers hit
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard has officially declared the Strait of Hormuz closed to all international maritime traffic following attacks on several oil tankers. This move comes after multiple vessels were damaged by mines near the strait and off the Saudi coast. Iranian authorities warned that any ship disregarding these new restrictions will face severe consequences.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኞች ሰራዊት በበርካታ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከቦች ላይ ጥቃት መድረሱን ተከትሎ የሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ለሁሉም አለም አቀፍ መርከቦች መዘጋቱን አስታውቋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው በባህር በሩ አቅራቢያ እና በሳውዲ አረቢያ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ በርካታ መርከቦች በፈንጂ መጎዳታቸውን ተከትሎ ነው። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ይህንን እገዳ የሚጥስ ማንኛውም መርከብ ከባድ አደጋ እንደሚገጥመው አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Raayyaan Ittisa Biyyaa Iraan gamtaan markaboota boba'aa irratti haleellaa erga raawwatamee booda, daandiin galaana Hormuz markaboota addunyaa maraaf cufaa ta'uusaa labseera. Murteen kun erga markaboonni baay'een daandii kana fi qarqara galaana Sa'udii Arabaa irratti miidhaa qaqqabsiisanii booda kan dhufe dha. Bulchiinsi Iraan markaboonni dhorkaa kana cabsan hundi miidhaa cimaaf akka saaxilaman akeekkachiiseera.

title: Egypt's Sisi declares his presidency will end in 2030
english: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi has officially stated that he will conclude his presidency in 2030. He emphasized that the constitution will not be amended and that his departure date is final. This announcement comes while his administration faces significant regional tensions and ongoing criticism regarding domestic human rights issues.
amharic: የግብፁ ፕሬዝዳንት አብዱል ፈታህ አል ሲሲ የፕሬዝዳንትነት ዘመናቸው በ2030 እንደሚጠናቀቅ በይፋ አስታውቀዋል። ህገ መንግስቱ እንደማይሻሻል እና ከስልጣን የሚለቁበት ጊዜ በአቋማቸው የጸና መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የወጣው መንግስታቸው በክልላዊ ውጥረቶች እና በሰብአዊ መብት አያያዝ ዙሪያ ከፍተኛ ትችቶች እየቀረቡበት ባለበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Masri Abduul Fattaah al-Sisiin aangoon isaanii bara 2030 akka xumuramu ifatti beeksisaniiru. Heera biyyattii irratti jijjiirama hin godhamneefi yeroon aangoo gad-lhiisan sun murtaawaa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Ibsi kun kan kenname mootummaan isaanii dhimmoota naannoofi mirga namoomaa irratti balaqqeessa jabaa keessa jiranuudha.

title: Sarah Helm is speaking 'common sense' on Palestine Action, says Zack Polanski
english: Journalist Sarah Helm is facing backlash from pro-Israel groups after she defended author Sally Rooney, whose books are being removed from UK stores due to her support for Palestine Action. While some critics requested a police investigation into Helm's comments on social media, Green Party leader Zack Polanski has publicly supported her stance. Helm criticized the suggestion that authors should be censored for their political views regarding Palestine.
amharic: ጋዜጠኛ ሳራ ሄልም የፍልስጤም አክሽን ደጋፊ ለሆነችው ደራሲ ሳሊ ሩኒ ድጋፍ በመስጠቷ በጽዮናውያን ቡድኖች ተቃውሞ ገጥሟታል። የሩኒ መጻሕፍት በእንግሊዝ ገበያ እንዳይሸጡ መደረጉን ተከትሎ ሄልም የሰጠችውን አስተያየት በመቃወም አንዳንድ አካላት በፖሊስ እንድትመረመር ጠይቀዋል። ሆኖም የአረንጓዴው ፓርቲ መሪ ዛክ ፖላንስኪ የሄልምን ንግግር ምክንያታዊ ነው በማለት ድጋፋቸውን ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Gaazexeessituun Saaraa Heelmii, deeggarsa ishee dhaabbata 'Palestine Action' fi barreessituu Saallii Ruuniif qabdu ibsuun ishee gareewwan Israa'el deeggarran biratti mormii kaaseera. Kitaabni Ruuniin barreeffaman gabaa UK keessaa akka bahan erga ta'ee booda, Heelmiin yaada ishee miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti waan ibsiteef qaamonni tokko tokko qorannoon poolisii irratti akka banamu gaafataniiru. Haa ta'u malee, hogganaan Paartii Magariisaa (Green Party) Zaak Polaanskitii yaada Heelmiin dhugaa fi ija jabina kan agarsiisu ta'uu dubbachuun ishee deggeranii jiru.

title: Sarah Helm doubles down as pro-Israel groups urge police action and Zack Polanski praises her 'bravery'
english: Journalist Sarah Helm is standing firm after pro-Israel advocacy groups demanded a police investigation into her social media comments supporting author Sally Rooney. The controversy began when Helm criticized calls to remove Rooney’s books from the market due to her pro-Palestine activism. While some groups want legal action against Helm, Green Party leader Zack Polanski has publicly defended her, labeling her remarks as courageous.

oromo: Gaazexeessituu Saaraa Heelam, deggartoota Israa'el biraa qeeqni erga ishee mudatee booda, yaada ishee gargaarsa Paalastinii irratti qabdu cimsattee itti fufteetti. Gareewwan tokko tokko ishee irratti tarkaanfiin seeraa akka fudhatamu gaafatanis, hogganaan Paartii magariisaa Zaak Polaansikii ibsa isheen kennite kan jajuu fi kan ishee deggeru ta'uu ibsaniiru.
